question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Anomalous
solution:
The opposite of "anomalous" is "customary".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Anomalous means something that is unusual or not expected(सामान्‍य से भिन्‍न, असामान्‍य, बेमेल, असंगत). Therefore, the opposite of anomalous would be something that is normal or expected, which is "customary".
 
• Option 1: Endemic means something that is native or restricted to a particular place or region(किसी विशेष स्‍थान या व्‍यक्ति वर्ग में नियमित रूप से पाया जाने वाला और जिससे छुटकारा मुश्किल है; जातीय, स्‍थानिक)
 
• Option 2: Outlandish means something that is bizarre or unconventional(अति विचित्र या असाधारण, अजीबोग़रीब या ग़ैर-मामूली).
 
• Option 4: Alien means something that is foreign or unfamiliar(अन्‍य लोकवासी, दूसरे ग्रह का वासी).
